description:
A collection of powershell functions for managing HP BIOS, and streamlining the download and organization of Softpaq downloads.


- [NEW] Adds support for Windows 11 26H1 and 26H2 to SoftPaq Management and SoftPaq Repository commands.
- [UPDATED] Updates Get-HPWarrantyInfo to support FIPS-enabled devices.
- [UPDATED] Updates Get-HPWarrantyInfo to use the rotated 2026 API key and to require CMSL 1.9.1 or later.
- [UPDATED] Updates Get-HPDock to read only from the installed WMI provider and to access the Internet only when AutoInstallWmiProvider is specified.
- [UPDATED] Updates the Security module which improves WWAN/cellular adapter detection and matching using WMI interface type, including IMEI/MEID matching via the Mobile Broadband API.
- [FIX] Fixes Invoke-HPTPMCredentialValidation on non-English Windows by parsing certificate key identifiers directly from ASN.1 instead of localized display strings.
- [FIX] Fixes Get-HPDock failing when the dock firmware index cannot be downloaded, and returns basic dock information instead when AutoInstallWmiProvider is specified.
- [FIX] Fixes error in Get-HPPrivatePSScriptsEntries, Add-HPPSScriptsEntry, and Remove-HPPSScriptsEntry when psscripts.ini contains only a single line.
- [FIX] Fixes error in Get-HPFirmwareAuditLog when the -Numeric parameter is specified.
- [FIX] Fixes unsuppressible console output and uses a more reliable method when determining the OS architecture in commands that detect OS bitness.
- [FIX] Fixes a result data type error in HP Private module.
- [FIX] Removes an invalid example from Get-HPUEFIVariable documentation.
